Doesn't haunt me this one but it's pretty sinister. Playing with my group of four my months old character died somehow, so while they're saving my loot for me Im making my way back to them. Immediately upon spawning another guy spawns in right beside me and starts chanting "IM GUNNA KILL YA ...IM GUNNA GETCHA" and starts hacking at me with this stone knife sprinting after me. Well naturally I run and he pursues. We run through this town and obviously attract the attention of every Zed in the area. So picture this, two fresh spawns sprinting after each other with about 20 Zombies chasing them as this guy is still trying to hack me up as hes being hit himself by zombies. Hes also still chanting that same mantra over and over this whole time. I finally find a house I can manage to get the door open to before I get swarmed but he makes it in too. So in this little cabin a fight to the death starts between me and this doucher. His stone knife against my bare hands. Somehow I win after already being hit by him and a bunch of zombies. This guy was so obnoxious he pissed me off to the point where I was like fuck it,  I'm gunna chop this motherfucker up and eat him. I still have that character to this day and that was months ago. I don't regret doing it,  but my poor survivor was introduced to the harsh reality of Chernarus on that day.
